case.title: Bruno Simon 风格驾驶式 3D
case.author: Bhavani_00007
case.summary: 作者公开的是一句让模型从零制作 Bruno Simon 风格 3D portfolio 的指令；没有更详细的完整 brief。
case.promptSourceText:
I used MiniMax M3 to build this 🤯

Gave it one prompt: build me a bruno-simon like 3D portfolio from scratch.

It wired physics, a drivable car, full portfolio sections, and even a self-driving tour mode, all on its own.

This shows how well M3 handles long, multi-part builds without losing track of the overall structure, exactly what its 1M context window is built for.

Also, the MiniMax Token Plan quota covers image, speech, music, and video generation, all sharing one usage pool. Kinda interesting.

A build this complex barely made a dent in the token budget.

The result is insane.
